Prepared & Packaged Soups.shortDescription: Stock your pantry with Maruchan Instant Lunch Roast Chicken Flavor ramen in convenient 2.25 oz cups. This multipack contains 24 cups packed as 2 manufacturer cartons with 12 cups per carton. Each cup combines ramen noodles with savory Roast Chicken Flavor and dehydrated vegetables. The cup format makes portioning straightforward: add hot water and follow the preparation directions printed on the cup. These shelf-stable cups are practical for a home pantry, office, dorm, break room, or emergency food supply. This listing is for Roast Chicken Flavor and 24 cups total; it is not the standard Chicken Flavor product.
